channel.title: The Drill Down: New York Jets
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Jets at Chargers
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: LAC -3 · O/U 40.5 | Model LAC 38% vs. market 59% | The Jets must turn red-zone trips into touchdowns, and they convert only 53% of them against a Chargers defense that allows 58%, a gap that often decides close games. Braelon Allen, who gains 1.5 yards over expected per carry, runs into a Chargers run defense ranked 26th. Our model disagrees with the market, putting the Jets at 62% against a 41% price, with the rushing matchup driving most of the gap.

item.title: Week 10: Bills at Jets
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: BUF -8.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model NYJ 33% vs. market 20% | Buffalo's passing game, ninth in EPA per dropback at +0.17, faces a Jets defense surrendering +0.09 per dropback, and that gap is where the Bills can pull away early. Khalil Shakir averages 4.4 yards of separation, and he will run into a Jets pass defense that ranks last in the league. We have Buffalo at 67%, below the market's 80%, but both sides land on the Bills, and the passing matchup supplies most of our lean.
